REQ-AUTH-001.title: Users can sign in with email and password
REQ-AUTH-001.description: Standard credential-based authentication. Email + password verified against a stored hash; on success a session token is issued.

API-AUTH-LOGIN.title: POST /auth/login
API-AUTH-LOGIN.description: Accepts email + password, returns a session token on success. Implements REQ-AUTH-001.

ENT-AUTH-USER.title: User
ENT-AUTH-USER.description: User record: id, email, password_hash, created_at.
